name: Tide Ledger
subtitle: Numbered invoice book
description: Example 16 — a payee issues numbered fixed-amount invoices; customers settle the exact amount for immediate payout, and settled slots are deleted, not flagged.
long_description: A one-directional invoice ledger for freelancers and small shops. The payee issues numbered invoices with a fixed amount and a payment deadline; a customer settles by sending exactly that amount and the payment forwards to the payee in the same call. The book never holds funds and takes no cut. Settling deletes the invoice slot rather than marking it paid, so double-payment is impossible by construction — the question cannot even be asked — and completed invoices leave no permanent per-invoice state. Proof of payment lives in the Settled event log and a single monotonic totalSettled scalar that doubles as an on-chain track record. The payee can void a mistaken invoice (the slot is refunded), and expired unpaid invoices can be purged by anyone to keep the ledger lean. An emergency brake can halt new issuance without ever blocking settlement.
